title: Add, subtract, multiply and divide
objective: Calculate with + - * / or with the words plus, minus, times and divided by, and see which part runs first.

body.text: Lagom has two ways to calculate. Symbols are short: + adds, - subtracts, * multiplies and / divides. Words are longer but read like English: plus, minus, times and divided by. Both ways give the same answer, so use whichever is clearer to you. Be consistent within one program.

body.title: Symbols and words
body.code:
make sum equal to 7 + 5
make difference equal to 20 minus 8
make product equal to 6 * 9
make quotient equal to 20 / 4
say sum
say difference
say product
say quotient

body.text: A calculation can have several steps. Multiplication and division happen before addition and subtraction, so 10 + 5 * 2 is 20, not 30. The same rule applies to the word forms, where times comes before plus.

body.title: Multiplication first
body.code:
make base equal to 10
make bonus equal to 5
make multiplier equal to 2
make total equal to base + bonus * multiplier
say total
make age equal to 12
say age plus 1
say age times 2

body.text: Parentheses change the order. Work inside the brackets first, then use the answer. Compare the two lines below. The brackets make the first one add before it multiplies.

body.title: Parentheses change the order
body.code:
make base equal to 2
make bonus equal to 3
make multiplier equal to 4
make total equal to (base plus bonus) times multiplier
say total
make count equal to 4
make average equal to 10 divided by (count plus 1)
say average

body.prompt: Make total equal to 2 + 3 * 4 using symbols. Multiplication happens first, so the program should print 14.
body.starter:
make total equal to 0
say total
body.solution:
make total equal to 2 + 3 * 4
say total
